resources.string: Without root, HyperNoti cannot keep Google Play services alive or guarantee FCM delivery. It helps you configure the phone; it does not run a keep-alive service.
Google Play services: installed and enabled
Google Play services: missing or disabled

For Google Play services and each app needing notifications: enable autostart where available, choose No restrictions for battery use, allow notifications, and allow background data. If your ROM has a Basic Google services switch, enable it. Menu names vary across HyperOS versions.
I enabled Google services on this ROM
I removed battery restrictions for affected apps
I allowed notifications and background data

From another device or the app’s notification sender, send a push to an affected app. Check once with the screen off, then after at least 15 minutes idle and after reboot. A local notification is not an FCM test. HyperNoti cannot verify delivery to other apps automatically.
This settings page is unavailable. Open Settings manually using the guide.
Confirmed steps: %1$d / 4. This is a checklist, not proof of FCM delivery.

Shizuku/root can request a standard Android Doze exemption and allow background app operations for the selected app. Xiaomi autostart is separate: use the HyperOS autostart page. These changes do not guarantee FCM or defeat every HyperOS restriction.

Installed application names are displayed only on this device and are not uploaded. Modify system settings is an optional user-granted permission for HyperNoti itself; it does not unlock autostart or grant privileged access.
Choose Shizuku or root. No elevated action runs automatically.
Shizuku permission denied. No changes were made.
Shizuku connected. Choose an app and confirm an action.
Start Shizuku and grant permission, then connect. Wireless-debugging Shizuku must be restarted after reboot.
Add this app to the Android Doze allowlist and set RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND to allow? This may increase battery usage. HyperOS can still restrict the app. Root prompts are handled by your root manager.
Remove this app from the user Doze allowlist and set RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND to default? This does not restore previous custom settings, and may remove an exemption added by another tool.
Inspect all exit codes: one change can succeed while another fails. Test real FCM on your device; command acceptance is not proof of delivery.
Choose an app and authorize Shizuku or root only when you need it.
Tap an app for system settings. Tap its shield for advanced actions.
